rehearsal_label: Fictional fixture-only process-evidence surface rehearsal — sample stewardship domain

source_material.summary: Fictional fixture pack of six process-transition receipts (session opened, deliberation entry recorded, decision recorded, accessibility-gate result, activation crossed, mutation plan recorded). No real people and no real domain; all hashes are illustrative.

decision_outcomes.plain_summary: A fictional stewardship decision was recorded against the sample session and left for a later rehearsal. The receipt records only that a decision artifact was recorded — by whom, when, and a content fingerprint — and asserts nothing about its standing.
The fixture accessibility-review gate recorded a pass result over the evidence surface. This reflects the fixture-simulated gate receipt, not a live gate run.

The recorded decision crossed from decision toward later action planning — accepted as ready to drive a later action-planning step, with the required gate observed as passed. The receipt records only that the crossing happened: it is not a mutation, grants zero authority, and the later action-planning (mutation planning) work remains deferred.

A mutation plan was recorded after activation and before any mutation was applied. The receipt references the activation it follows and fingerprints the plan body as a content hash. It records only that the plan record exists: it does not apply the plan, expose the plan body, or grant authority — mutation application and evidence-packet production both remain deferred.

preview_review_boundary.notes: Read-first, no mutation: the surface renders committed receipts only; no write path is exercised.

mutation_boundary.notes: Fixture-only rehearsal; no gateway contacted, no write attempted, no network egress. The activation crossing and the mutation-plan recording are process facts, not mutations — recording a plan is not applying it; mutation application and evidence-packet production remain deferred and are not part of this surface.

warnings: The six process-transition receipt hashes are illustrative fixture values, not real blake3 bindings; nothing is signed.
This surface renders read views only; no live gateway, federation, or production posture is implied.

follow_ups.title: Human assistive-technology accessibility pass for member-shell v0 (screen-reader, low-vision zoom, switch input)

privacy_review.notes: One fictional deliberation input is shown to the steward body in summary and redacted from the member and export views; the receipt stores a body hash only, so there is no stored text to leak.

accessibility_review.notes: The automated, structural accessibility floor (axe-core WCAG, keyboard reachability with visible focus, landmarks, 200% zoom render) was reviewed clean on this fixture surface. The human assistive-technology categories (screen-reader, low-vision, switch input) remain pending under icn#2041 and are not claimed here.

non_claims: Not a formally committed cooperative pilot.
Not a live federation, live Google Drive / Groups / Sheets sync, or any K3s / DNS / Forgejo mutation.
Not private-data handling; all material is fictional and repo-safe by construction.
Not organizer-ready or member-ready; this is a dev/fixture evidence view only.
Not a new receipt class; it reads the six existing ADR-0026 Layer 2 process-transition receipts only (mutation plan recorded landed in icn#2303).

Not a mutation, a planned or applied mutation, an action card, or an evidence-packet producer; activation records only that a decision crossed toward later action planning, and the mutation-plan receipt records only that a plan was recorded — recording a plan is not applying it, and application plus evidence-packet production remain deferred.
Not a plan body, operation list, target list, effect payload, or typed/kernel-readable mutation-plan operation model; the mutation-plan receipt carries a body-hash fingerprint only.
Not NYCN activation and not Phase 2 completion.
